summary: Named only on a Georgia tower list as 'sapelo' in McIntosh County (GA262, code gfc-133); absent from NHLR's Georgia register, and no source found describes the tower.

evidence.supports: List row: sapelo at 31.59140, -81.41809 in McIntosh County, code GA262 with gfc-133
The list's codes run from GA001
The list numbers its entries up to GA427
The list's note ties gfc-nnn codes to an older GFC list that described 203 towers
evidence.quote: an older GFC list described the locations of 203 towers (gfc-nnn).

evidence.supports: The list's author says names for towers 73 and above are the author's own creation; GA262 is one of them
evidence.quote: For towers 73 and above, names are my creation.

evidence.supports: Source is a list titled Georgia lookout towers
NHLR's Georgia register counts 29 registered lookouts
evidence.quote: There are 29 lookouts registered in Georgia.

corrections.proposed: gfc-133 (the list's note says gfc-nnn codes come from an older GFC list of 203 towers)
corrections.why: The list gives the code as gfc-133. The label GFC US 133 does not appear in the source.

notes_for_editor: Only one source names this tower: the tnlandforms Georgia list (2016 revision), which gives name, coordinates, county, an unlabelled figure 22 (feet, probably elevation; not used in the story) and the gfc-133 code. Not in the NHLR Georgia register. The name overlaps Sapelo Island, which has its own lighthouse (Wikipedia: Sapelo Island Light). The story mentions the lighthouse only to prevent confusion; no source ties this list site to the island or confirms its location, so do not link the lighthouse record to this tower. Two WebSearch queries, a combined FFLA chapter-report search, and Wikipedia pages (Sapelo Island, Sapelo Island Light, the Georgia tower list) found nothing about a tower here. Status and access are unknown and left out.
